payload.message:
Deliver any ready ClipDetector clips to Telegram.

1. Run: curl -s http://localhost:8000/api/automation/ready-clips
2. If the response is an empty array, stop — there's nothing to deliver.
3. For each clip in the array, send it to Telegram using the message tool with:
   - media: the clip's "url" field (e.g. http://localhost:8000/data/clips/AbCdEfGh_vertical.mp4)
   - text: "{channel} — {vod_title}"
4. After each successful send, mark it delivered: curl -sX POST http://localhost:8000/api/automation/clips/{filename}/delivered
5. After all clips are sent and marked, clean up disk space: curl -sX POST http://localhost:8000/api/automation/cleanup-delivered
